verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a meeting-transcription SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Otter shipping a self-hosted or on-prem deployment: the documented capabilities are cloud services, a public API, an MCP server, and exports to S3 or Google Drive. Those exports are data-portability features, not self-hosting of the core product, and community users note that recordings go to a cloud they don't control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
